qr.frac: Mixed numbers go improper; dividing means flip and multiply.
qr.distrib: The number outside the parentheses hits every term inside.
qr.cross: Whatever crosses the equals sign changes its sign.
qr.parts: Add the parts for the whole, find one part, then scale.
qr.scale: Keep like units over like units, then scale.
qr.pct-mult: Back-to-back percents multiply as factors; never add them.
qr.pct-undo: To undo a percent change, divide by the factor.
qr.pct-of: Percent of means multiply. Find 10 percent first, then scale.
qr.exp-root: In a^(m/n), the bottom is the root and the top is the power.
qr.exp-rules: Multiply powers: add exponents. Power of a power: multiply them.
qr.cone: Same base, same height: a cone is one third of the cylinder.
qr.dice: Two dice make 36 ordered rolls; 7 is the peak with 6 ways.
qr.totals: Means hide totals: mean times count gives the sum.
qr.work: Together means add the rates, never the times.
qr.decimals: Put every number in one form before you combine.
qr.start-rate: Start plus rate times time: take off the start, then divide.
qr.part-whole: Probability is part over whole: the whole is everything.
qr.no-repl: Without replacement, the top and the bottom both drop by one.
qr.median: Median means sort first; an even count averages the middle two.
qr.per: Per means divide: let the units pick the operation.
qr.doubling: n doublings multiply by 2^n, and the start is not a doubling.
qr.cyl: A cylinder is a stack of circles: pi r^2 times the height.
qr.radius: Radius or diameter? Check before you use pi r^2.
qr.system: Solve the system all the way, then answer what they asked.
qr.lcd: Common denominator first, then combine the tops with their signs.
qr.roots: Roots join over times and divide, never over plus or minus.
qr.like-roots: Simplify every root to the same radical, then add the fronts.
qr.sa-cube: Surface area over 6 is one face; its square root is the edge.
qr.mix: Track the pure stuff; the total grows by what you add.
qr.order: Multiply and divide before you add or subtract.
qr.sq-diff: x^2 - y^2 is a signal: factor it into (x + y)(x - y).
qr.chain: To chain two ratios, make the shared term match first.
qr.composite: Break the solid into standard pieces, then add them.
qr.cases: Split same or different into cases: AND multiplies, OR adds.
qr.check-roots: Squaring can invent roots. Plug each one back in.
qr.ratio-k: Give each ratio part a multiplier k, then apply the changes.
qr.exp-block: Treat 2^x as a block; you never need x itself.
qr.sq-factor: A squared length gets its factor squared.
qr.repeat: A repeating two-digit block is that block over 99.
qr.sum-sq: (a + b)^2 has a middle term, 2ab. Never drop it.
qr.snug: A snug sphere fills two thirds of its cylinder.
qr.combos: Exactly k of a kind: multiply the combinations, divide by the total.
qr.maximize: To make one value big, push every other value to its smallest.
qr.drain: Each drain and refill keeps the same fraction: multiply it in.
qr.recip-sq: x times 1/x is 1, so each square adds a cross term of 2.
qr.variation: Write the variation as one equation, find k once, reuse it.
qr.complement: At least one of each: the total minus the one-group cases.
qr.stages: When the setup changes midway, split into stages with their own rates.
qr.unit-rate: Find the unit rate, then scale.
qr.estimate: Round to friendly numbers, then count the zeros.
qr.or-rule: OR adds, then takes the overlap out once.
qr.disc: One real root means the discriminant b^2 - 4ac is zero.
qr.both-roots: Isolate x^2, then take both roots, plus and minus.
qr.sum-roots: Roots of x^2 + bx + c add to -b and multiply to c.
qr.net-rate: Opposing rates subtract; time is amount over the net rate.
qr.equal-bases: Same base on both sides, then set the exponents equal.
qr.shift: Add a constant to every value: every center moves by it.
qr.diag: A cube's space diagonal is s sqrt(3); a face diagonal is s sqrt(2).
qr.lcd-eq: Multiply every term on both sides by the LCD.
qr.foil: Square, double the product, square. Never drop the middle.
qr.factor-cancel: Factor first; only whole factors cancel.
qr.zero-product: Get a product equal to 0, then set each factor to 0.
qr.vertex: The vertex sits at x = -b/(2a); plug it back in for y.
qr.log: A log is an exponent: rewrite it as a power.
qr.sci: Coefficients with coefficients, powers of ten with powers of ten.
qr.conj: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate.
qr.abs: An absolute value splits into two cases. Check each one.
qr.flip-ineq: Multiply or divide by a negative, and the sign flips.
qr.range-diff: For the biggest x - y, take the biggest x and the smallest y.
qr.slope: Slope is rise over run, same point first on top and bottom.
qr.perp: Perpendicular slopes: flip it and switch the sign.
qr.midpoint: Midpoint averages the coordinates; distance is Pythagoras.
qr.compose: Inside function first, then feed its output to the outer one.
qr.inverse: f^{-1}(a) asks which input gives the output a.
qr.undo: To isolate a letter, undo the operations around it in reverse order.
qr.scale-cube: Lengths scale by k, areas by k^2, volumes by k^3.
qr.vertex-form: In y = a(x - h)^2 + k, the vertex is (h, k): flip the h sign only.
qr.inverse-prop: Inverse means the product stays fixed: P1V1 = P2V2.
qr.half-life: Count the half-lives first, then halve that many times.
qr.pct-base: Percent change divides by the starting value.
qr.read-chart: Read the scale and the condition words before you count.
qr.weighted: Groups of different sizes: weight by size, never average the percents.
qr.zero-denom: Check every answer in the original; a zero denominator rules it out.
qr.translate: Name one unknown, write the rest from it, then solve.
